name: Gera
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy

points: And when king David came to Bahurim, behold, thence came out a man of the family of the house of Saul, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera: he came forth, and cursed still as he came.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Shimei son of Gera
cases.charge: Cursing the king and casting stones at him: come out, come out, thou bloody man, and thou man of Belial
